props.gloss_en: the mishna: the kidneys removed [-- fit]
Rakhish bar Pappa in Rav's name: diseased in one kidney -- tereifa
the West: and that is where the disease reached the place of the crevice
and where is the place of the crevice? at the white [matter] beneath the loins
the halakha is as Rakhish bar Pappa
and the halakha is not as Rav Avira
and as to Rav Avira too, we said [the halakha is not as he] only in its thin end
a spleen perforated in its thin end -- [fit]
but in its thick end -- tereifa
and if there remains in it the thickness of a gold dinar -- fit
the West: whatever disqualifies in the lung is fit in the kidney
for a perforation disqualifies in the lung
and is fit in the kidney
R' Tanchuma: pus -- fit in the lung
and unfit in the kidney
and clear fluid, which is fit here and here
Rav Ashi: are you comparing tereifot to one another? one does not say of tereifot 'this is like that'
for one cuts it here and it dies, cuts it there and it lives
and clear fluid is fit -- we said so only where it is unclouded
but clouded -- tereifa
and even unclouded, we said so only where it is not fetid
but fetid -- tereifa
a kidney that shrank: in a small animal -- until a bean
in a large animal -- until a medium grape
